userdoc.notice: Auto-compounding full-range vaults on any Uniswap V4 pool, hooked or not. Deposit one token (or both); the vault balances it with a swap in the same pool, adds it to a single full-range position, and issues shares. Swap fees are folded back into the position on every deposit, withdrawal, and whenever anyone calls `compound`, so a share only ever grows in liquidity. Withdraw to both tokens, or zap out to one. Money rules: `perfFeeBps` (default 5%, hard cap 10%) of harvested fees goes to the treasury. Nothing is charged on deposits or withdrawals. Withdrawals work while paused.
